title: one person's failure never stops the next person's turn
line: a turn that fails outside its runs' own reading and requests and its tail's parts stops there, what it had not committed rolled back; the runner names it with its exception, passes its person over for the rest of the run with that reason, and goes on to the next person's turn

steps.say: the home person's parents confirmed on the owner's word, so the grandparents are at the edge
three turns, the first connector run of the run raising (the harness's stand-in for a turn that fails): it is the grandfather's
